## Summary

Declare Atom/(.Role := Plan)

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan) >| (Container == yes);

Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan);

# instances
Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$plan {::0+}((CONTAINS)) Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$contained_plan;

Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$dependent {::0+}((IS_BLOCKED_BY)) Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$prerequisite;

Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$prerequisite_2 {::0+}((BLOCKS)) Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$dependent_2;

Atom/(.Header.Context.Role: Plan)//$atom;

IF (($atom.Header.State.Status = Active) AND ($atom.Header.Context.Plan.Work Sequence Number{=1}))
THEN ($atom.Header.Context.Container{==1})
```

## Semantics

A Plan describes bounded intended work or an intended outcome.
